epic.title: Epic #568 — spine ownership and lifecycle
epic.intent_and_why: Make engine state carry location and ownership, remain correct under concurrency, and die when its owner does.

definition_of_done: Every authorized issue is merged, closed on an honest measured null, deferred by ruling, or floated with evidence.
Every positive fix has a pre-fix failure and post-fix proof.
Linux and non-Windows CI are green; Windows-only failures are recorded but allowed.

good_enough.mandatory_quality: Engine-core implementation serialized, independent review, and no check that cannot register failure.
good_enough.sufficient_evidence: Live repro, targeted tests, relevant broader suite, exact CI node-set evidence, and verified merge state.
good_enough.appetite: One wave containing five authorized items, with lifecycle floated if its measured shape becomes materially complex.

hard_constraints: All spine interaction is through MCP, never the engine CLI.
Only one implementation Commander at a time may edit checklist_engine.py, spine_rail.py, or agent_work_root.py.
A lower-tier agent may not adjudicate architecture, production behavior, or final engine-core review.
fixed_decisions: Windows-only CI failures are non-blocking for this wave; any non-Windows failure blocks.
Merges are delegated after exact-head pinning, independent APPROVE, and required evidence.

current_wave.objective: Land engine-native worktree isolation against a stored spine origin and remove the command check that could not fail.
exit_criteria: The engine enforces its own cwd against that origin.
The obsolete command check is replaced with behavior tests.
Independent review approves and post-promotion Linux verification is green.
